ia.ia-pode-cometer-erros-imagem: AI may make mistakes when transcribing images, especially when dealing with mathematical formulas, which can compromise important elements. Additionally, some images may be low resolution or contain many elements and objects, making accurate transcription even more difficult. Therefore, it is essential to verify that the information has been correctly interpreted.
ia.ia-pode-cometer-erros-texto: AI may present inaccuracies in reading and interpreting typed texts, especially when they involve mathematical formulas or more complex structures. Therefore, it is essential to carefully review the generated information to ensure that all elements are correct and complete.

ia.nao-suporta-svg: It is not possible to optimize images generated by the formula tool.
